modmenu.summaryTranslation.herzium: Responsive hotbar previews with three selection-order preferences.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.herzium: Choose Vanilla, last-input or lowest-slot priority. Herzium (last input) is the default and changes real slot selection; Vanilla order keeps Vanilla selection. Input sampling is unchanged and no click is ever sent sooner; a click can wait one tick so it runs with the item of its own key.
herzium.warning.title: ABOUT HERZIUM
herzium.warning.message: Priority Hotbar previews the selected order on the next rendered frame. Items appear in hand without the equip dip, combat items included; the Feel tab of the settings gives those Vanilla's transition back. Mod Menu offers Vanilla order, Herzium (last input), and Vanilla reversed (lowest slot). Herzium (last input) is the default: among slots with pending clicks the last pressed binding wins, which changes the real selected slot and may change the item used on a server. It is not Vanilla-equivalent; choose Vanilla order in Mod Menu to keep Vanilla selection. Input sampling, normal/remapped click processing and cooldown handling retain their existing paths.
herzium.warning.notice.raw_input_buffer: Raw Input Buffer is installed. Herzium does not change its pipeline or Vanilla Raw Input.
herzium.warning.notice.ixeris: Ixeris is installed. Herzium does not change its pipeline or Vanilla Raw Input.
herzium.warning.notice.inventory_tweaks: KoHs Inventory Tweaks owns Cursor Landing. Herzium never changes Raw Input or cursor placement.
herzium.warning.notice.both_pipelines: Raw Input Buffer and Ixeris are both installed. Their external mouse pipelines overlap; Herzium does not mediate them. Remove one.
herzium.warning.notice.exordium: Exordium is installed. Herzium bypasses its HUD cache, so that part of Exordium is inactive while both mods run.
herzium.warning.tip.0: Herzium removes waiting, not work. It adds no frames.
herzium.warning.tip.1: Vanilla order prefers the highest slot when several slot clicks are pending.
herzium.warning.tip.2: Herzium never speeds up the server's 20 ticks per second.
herzium.warning.tip.3: Alternative orders change the real winning slot, not just its highlight.
herzium.warning.tip.4: Every item takes the hand at once. The Feel tab gives combat items Vanilla's equip animation back.
herzium.warning.tip.5: Fabric API is not required. VSync and frame limits remain Vanilla-owned.
herzium.warning.tip.6: Order is a preference for simultaneous slot inputs, not faster clicking.
herzium.config.title: Herzium · Priority Hotbar
herzium.config.order.label: Order: %s
herzium.config.order.vanilla.description: When several hotbar slots have pending clicks, the highest slot wins. Example: 1 + 9 selects 9.
herzium.config.order.herzium.description: The key you pressed last wins. Example: 9 then 1 selects 1. Every click then runs with the item of its own key: a burst goes one key per tick, a click that lands a moment before its key goes with that key, and a button you keep held waits with its click. Nothing is sent sooner than Vanilla would send it, and no click is created.
herzium.config.order.vanilla_reversed.de: When several hotbar slots have pending clicks, the lowest slot wins. Example: 1 + 9 selects 1.
herzium.feature.preview.description: The hotbar and the hand show the slot of the key you pressed on the next frame, without waiting for the game tick (up to 50 ms). Only drawing: the real selection still happens in the tick and no packet is sent sooner.
herzium.feature.preview_recovery.descrip: If the preview and the game ever disagree about the slot, the preview stops, so the screen never lies. Before 1.12 it stayed off until you changed world, and the hotbar felt slow for the rest of the match. With this on it comes back after 3 seconds.
herzium.feature.swap_preview.description: An offhand swap is drawn at once, in the hands and in the hotbar, instead of when the server answers, your ping later. Only drawing: if the server has not confirmed it in half a second, the screen shows the real items again.
herzium.feature.combat_preview.descripti: Swords, axes, maces, tridents and the other combat items take the hand at once too, like every other item. Off in a fresh install: they keep Vanilla's equip animation, which is how Vanilla shows the attack cooldown starting again; the attack indicator shows that cooldown either way.
herzium.feature.slot_pop.description: The item of the slot you select makes Vanilla's small bounce, the one an item makes when it arrives in the hotbar. A confirmation, as fast as your frames, that the key was read. Only drawing.
herzium.feature.no_equip_dip.description: Ordinary items appear in the hand at once, without the lowering and raising that hides them for a few frames. Combat items keep that animation unless "Combat items too" is on.
herzium.feature.smooth_indicator.descrip: The attack indicator advances every frame inside the tick instead of jumping once per tick. It never shows more charge than the game would give the hit.
herzium.feature.response_meter.descripti: Shows in the bottom left corner of the HUD how long your last hotbar key took to reach the screen and to reach the game tick, in milliseconds. Measured, never estimated. The same numbers are here below.
herzium.feature.shape_monitor.descriptio: Watches the packets this client sends, whichever mod causes them, for three things a server can tell from Vanilla: a hotbar change after a click of the same tick, the same slot sent twice in a row, and two placements in one tick. It only counts; nothing is changed. The first two must stay at 0: Vanilla never sends them.
herzium.kohs.name: Zymekoh
herzium.kohs.role: KoHs Mod Suite is a one-person studio: every mod and plugin, its code, screens, art and updates, is made by Zymekoh. Tools that make Minecraft PvP sharper and better looking, built for fair play.
herzium.kohs.role_short: Every KoHs mod and plugin, its code, art and updates, made by one person for fair PvP.
herzium.config.vanilla_note: Vanilla behavior; not the default. Input sampling and normal/remapped clicks keep their existing timing. Repeated slot presses retain Vanilla's queue.
herzium.config.alternate_note: This changes real slot selection and can affect which item is used on a server. It is not Vanilla-equivalent; follow the server's mod rules. A click can wait one tick, never go sooner.
